items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: Now I've got two other, I've got two other electric basses, but that's the first one, you know, that I've had. That's when I was playing with Danny White with, you know. Danny Lecter, that's the name.

ctx.x: I bet it's a Fender, right? Yeah.
Now I've got two other, no it's a Danny Lecter. Is that Dan Electro?
